name: Topics — Main Subjects
sql:
WITH selected AS (
    SELECT reference || '@' || CAST(COALESCE("header.state.version", "header.version") AS VARCHAR) AS atom_version,
           CASE
               WHEN "header.context.topics.main_subject" IS NOT NULL THEN ["header.context.topics.main_subject"]
               WHEN json_type("header.topics.main_subject") = 'VARCHAR' THEN [CASE WHEN json_type("header.topics.main_subject") = 'VARCHAR' THEN json_extract_string("header.topics.main_subject", '$') END]
               ELSE list_concat(
                   TRY_CAST(json_extract("header.topics.main_subject", '$.continuant') AS VARCHAR[]),
                   TRY_CAST(json_extract("header.topics.main_subject", '$.occurrent') AS VARCHAR[])
               )
           END AS main_subjects,
           CASE
               WHEN json_type(COALESCE("header.context.topics.dependencies", "header.topics.dependencies")) = 'ARRAY'
                   THEN TRY_CAST(COALESCE("header.context.topics.dependencies", "header.topics.dependencies") AS VARCHAR[])
               ELSE list_concat(
                   TRY_CAST(json_extract("header.topics.dependencies", '$.continuant') AS VARCHAR[]),
                   TRY_CAST(json_extract("header.topics.dependencies", '$.occurrent') AS VARCHAR[])
               )
           END AS dependencies
    FROM atoms
    WHERE status_group = 'Current'
    AND starts_with(relative_path, '.caprmedio_caprmedio')
    AND NOT starts_with(relative_path, '.caprmedio_caprmedio/000_CAPRMEDIO_framework')
    AND regexp_full_match(reference, 'CA-[CAPRMEDO]-[0-9]+')
)
SELECT topic AS main_subject, list(DISTINCT atom_version ORDER BY atom_version) AS atom_versions
FROM selected, UNNEST(main_subjects) AS occurrences(topic)
WHERE topic IS NOT NULL AND trim(topic) <> '' AND atom_version IS NOT NULL AND length(list_distinct(list_filter(main_subjects, lambda value: value IS NOT NULL AND trim(value) <> ''))) = 1
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY lower(topic), topic
